Title: Data Wiki Policy — This Directory
Content: The data/ directory at the SplitBrain.AI repository root is a MemorySmith wiki for this project. To use it: point MemorySmith's DataPath at <repo>/data/. data/Memories/ contains JSON memory records (Core=durable facts, Working=active state, Deprecated=archived, Unconsolidated=raw captures). data/Pages/ contains markdown documentation pages (no YAML front matter; pure markdown starting with # Title). data/Graph/code-search/ holds the SQLite code search index at runtime (gitignored). data/Policies/tag-policy.json governs tag governance. data/vars.json maps %SplitBrainRepo% to the local clone path. Codesearch is configured in MemorySmith's appsettings.json pointing at src/ subdirectories.
